notes:
WhaleChat 3.63.0 — chat is smooth again, stickers and status control, and a new admin Servers & API space.

• Typing is never interrupted: the chat screen no longer rebuilds itself for background changes (typing notices, delivery ticks, presence heartbeats, incoming messages). New bubbles, ✓✓ ticks and the “typing…” line are painted in place, so the composer, the text, the caret and the keyboard stay exactly where they are — no more shaking or blinking while chatting.
• The keyboard opens once per chat instead of flashing on every refresh, and sending a message keeps the composer focused and the message list still.
• Stickers: send built-in sticker packs from the chat composer, save any sticker to My stickers on your account (it follows you to every device), make a sticker from a photo, and see recent stickers.
• Status: delete any status you posted from Status → Your updates (one tap) as well as from the viewer.
• Admin → Servers & API: connect app servers by hand (URL is health-probed and stored) and connect the Brevo email server (key verified, sender saved, test email). Both are stored on the server and survive every deploy.
• Email (verification codes, test mail, broadcasts) now uses the email server connected in the admin panel, with the Worker secret as fallback.
• Faster chat: fewer full-screen rebuilds, fewer reflows, less work per message.
